cues.text: Bid, or no bid? Five questions to ask first.
One. Is it really your trade? Read the scope, not the title.
Two. Can you deliver at this size, on this schedule?
Three. Is it somewhere you actually serve?
Four. Can you make every date, including a mandatory site meeting?
Five. Can you meet every mandatory requirement? Bonding, insurance, registrations.
One no, and it's a pass.
I ask these on every opportunity, so you only see the ones that pass. Phildave.com.
